name: gh_pull_merge
description: Merge a pull request: closes it, sets merged_at and merge_commit_sha, records the merge commit, and advances the base branch (PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/merge)

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

pull_number.description: The number that identifies the pull request.

commit_title.description: Title for the automatic commit message.

merge_method.description: The merge method to use. Can be one of: merge, squash, rebase. Default: merge.
